Name: Character Scarecrows for Alternative Textures (AT)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img]

Scarecrows in the shape of Stardew Valley villagers.
Yes, it's a little weird, but the crows will stay away because they think so, too.

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]  

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file(s) and extract into your /Mods folder

There .zip file contains several folders:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][AT] Character Scarecrows[/size]
[*][size=3][AT] Character Scarecrows (Beach Outfits)[/size]
[*][size=3][AT] Character Scarecrows (Special Characters)[/size]
[*][size=3][AT] Character Scarecrows (Special Poses)[/size]
[*][size=3][AT] Character Scarecrows (Suits and Dresses)[/size]
[/list][size=3]Check the screenshots for which scarecrows are in which folder, and delete the folders you don't want.
[/size][/list][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_use.png[/img]

This mod only changes the [i]look[/i] of the bus - it will still function the same way as before.

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_bugreports.png[/img]

If you have any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][b]-[/b]specific issues, please direct them to the devs on their respective mod page.﻿

Please report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img] 
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_credits.png[/img]

Assets edited and packaged for Alternative Textures by me.
Please do not re-use or re-share anywhere without my permission.
